new_file_rule: All augmented selectors live in new pytest file tests/test_annotated_aug.py via eval_tests_aug.patch.

tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_annota.public_surface: FastAPI route decorator plus TestClient form request using Annotated[str, fastapi.params.Form()].
tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_annota.coverage_goal: Exercises the Annotated branch that accepts the Form metadata class without requiring a duplicate positional default.
tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_annota.internal_symbol_check: No FastAPI internals imported; test uses fastapi.FastAPI, fastapi.params.Form, and TestClient.

tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_annota.public_surface: FastAPI route decorator plus TestClient multipart request using Annotated[bytes, fastapi.params.File()].
tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_annota.coverage_goal: Exercises the Annotated branch that accepts the File metadata class without requiring a duplicate positional default.
tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_annota.internal_symbol_check: No FastAPI internals imported; test uses fastapi.FastAPI, fastapi.params.File, and TestClient.

tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_plain_.public_surface: FastAPI route decorator plus TestClient GET requests for ordinary query-parameter defaults.
tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_plain_.stability_goal: Guards non-Annotated default query parameter behavior while Annotated metadata consumption is added.
tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_plain_.internal_symbol_check: No FastAPI internals imported; test uses fastapi.FastAPI and TestClient.

coverage_validation.measurement_note: Coverage measured with coverage.py over solution.patch Python lines; union mode runs original plus augmented F2P/P2P selectors.
